text:
carla: opening NimbusHealth RFI thread. they want an audit-ready POC: embeddings + rerank for patient search, must demonstrate Private/VPC option, bring-your-own-HSM, SSO (SAML) and show 99th pctl latency targets. timeline: 3 weeks. who can own matrix + sec answers?

ben: I can do the capability matrix. need peak QPS and typical context lengths. do we have their spreadsheet?

carla: uploaded RFI pdf to drive: https://drive.redwood/nimbus/rfi.pdf. they list peak embed QPS 75, sustained 20, avg tokens 18, long contexts up to 1024 tokens.

tara: 75 QPS is fine on Hosted with caching + batching. for Private latency-sensitive workloads we'd recommend 2x L4 or 1x H100. POC approach: start Hosted dedicated pool with KV caching, then validate Private for residency and HSM.

mike: pricing ask: monthly run-rate for Hosted managed, Dedicated reserved baseline, and Private one-time infra + monthly support. roughs?

ben: early ballpark: Hosted (managed, caching): ~$10k/mo. Dedicated reserved (2x L4 baseline): ~$30k/mo. Private: one-time infra/deploy ~$60k + ~$7k/mo support. mark as estimates.

carla: add KMS/HSM question: customer requires FIPS 140-2 HSM and BYOK. can Private support this immediately? any lead time?

tara: Private supports customer-managed KMS and HSM-backed key stores. lead time for HSM provisioning ~3 weeks (vendor dependent). add note: "HSM available for Private; provisioning lead time typically 3+ weeks."

ben: security Q about logs: do we persist raw request payloads by default? need exact wording for questionnaire.

tara: wording: "Hosted: request metadata retained 30 days; payloads redacted by default unless customer opts in. Private: customer controls retention and may enable full logging."

mike: they asked for explicit latency rows in the matrix for embeddings at 18 tokens and 1024 tokens (99th pctl). what numbers?

tara: suggested numbers: "Embeddings (18 tokens): 99th pctl 70ms (Hosted cached), 140ms (Private baseline)" and "Embeddings (1024 tokens): 99th pctl 260ms (Hosted cached), 550ms (Private baseline)". add KV cache note: typical reduction 25-40% for repeated prefixes.

ben: function/tool-calling in Private? they need webhooks back into hospital systems (internal only).

tara: Private supports outbound webhooks and local tool bridge; customers must provide network allowlist and firewall rules. doc: https://docs.redwood/private-tooling. Include note about synchronous timeouts for callbacks.

carla: SLA ask: they want contractual 99.9% availability for POC. can we commit?

mike: we don't contractually SLA POCs. recommended wording: "POC: best-effort performance with monitoring; contractual SLA available upon Dedicated or Private contract and full onboarding."

ben: envoy-bot, can you drop the draft CSV matrix link?

envoy-bot: uploaded file: https://files.redwood/cap-matrix/nimbus_matrix_v1.csv :white_check_mark:

mike: include a short test curl snippet for their engineers to smoke-test embeddings. also show example idempotency header for batch ingest.

ben: adding snippet to matrix notes:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: nimbus-smoke-01" \
  -d '{"model":"r-instruct-emb-1","input":"patient symptoms summary"}'
```

carla: export controls question: legal asked if we can confirm. pinging legal.

mike: provisional language: "Standard U.S. export control regulations apply. For restricted jurisdictions, we recommend Private deployment and legal review."

ben: final checklist for RFI bundle: capability matrix with latency rows & pricing, security Q responses PDF, HSM caveat, ops runbook (network peering, KMS steps), and smoke-test snippet. planning to assemble PDF and send to Nimbus procurement Thu morning.

carla: thank you — if you hit blockers call out now. I'll collate and produce the final RFI bundle. :rocket:
